summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the Table 1 activity extraction, reconciled database rows to source-supported PH-1 evidence, preserved aggregate database conflicts as cautions, and closed the prior targeted rework without fabricating supplement/image-derived values.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework completed for doi__10.1371_journal.pone.0018550 with publication-grade acceptance carrying explicit database-aggregate cautions.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, Results/Methods text, XML Table 1, Figures 1-9 captions, antifungal assay and SYTOX method sections

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check of Table 1, growth inhibition prose, figure captions, and methods text

oa_package.coverage: NXML/PDF, Table 1 image, Figures 1-9, and supplementary TIF members listed in the OA package manifest

supplementary_assets.coverage: Landing-page HTML and TIF figure supplements were checked; they add figure/motif context but no structured activity/toxicity table beyond primary Table 1.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DBAASP assay rows matched to Table 1 where possible; CAMP/dbAMP aggregate rows preserved as source_conflict when identity or extra organism claims exceed local paper support.

supplementary_assets.note: Local supplementary assets are HTML/TIF figure surfaces, not structured spreadsheets; no accepted row depends on unsupported image digitization.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP Table-1-linked assay and literature rows are source-verified; CAMP/dbAMP aggregate rows that include ambiguous names, missing sequence snapshots, or unsupported extra organism claims remain source_conflict cautions rather than being smoothed into verification.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: XML Table 1 supports 28 activity rows covering 14 entities and IC50/IC100 endpoints against F. graminearum PH-1 with µM units and locators; no toxicity rows are reported in this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: SYTOX Green uptake provides direct membrane-permeabilization evidence; growth inhibition and morphology/glucoceramide results are phenotype-supported or inferred context and are not overclaimed as a single molecular target.

semantic_quality_checks.nonblocking_supplement_note: Supplementary figures were checked as figure/caption surfaces; no structured supplement table values were required for accepted rows.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP rows may include ambiguous names, absent sequence snapshots, or non-PH-1 organism/value claims not fully supported by this local primary paper; those rows are preserved as source_conflict where appropriate.
Primary source Table 1 reports IC100/complete conidial-germination inhibition; database MIC labels are crosswalked but do not replace the source endpoint label.

source_review_depth_summary: paper_xml, paper_pdf, oa_package, supplementary_assets, and merged_database_rows reopened from handoff paths and packet-local artifacts.
